member.name: SubscribeTunnelingTextInput
member.summary: Subscribes the handler that carries the commit-character policy on the tunneling text-input stage, which runs before the text area raises TextEntering, so the policy does not depend on the subscription order of the host's own input services.
member.param: The handler that receives the typed text.
member.returns: A subscription that removes the handler when it is disposed.
member.remarks: The stage is PreviewTextInput in WPF and the tunnel pass of TextInput in Avalonia. Programmatic input through PerformTextInput bypasses it.

member.name: SubscribeItemClick

member.param: The completion-list list box to subscribe.
The handler that receives the list box and the click event.
member.returns: A subscription that removes the handler when it is disposed.

member.name: FindClickedItem
